findings.issue: The run records per-mode MIR claims (`function_name`, decoded SHA, full-function-record path/SHA, and graph inventory) and per-row source metadata, but the physical audit does not validate those claims against the captured decoded files or reconstructed constructor metadata. `_audit_case` checks the case artifact inventory and stage records, yet never reads `row['mir']` or `row['source_metadata']`. A changed MIR path/hash/function name/graph summary or control metadata can therefore coexist with an audit marked complete, so the advertised source/MIR capture record is not fully bound to its physical inputs.
findings.required_fix: In the read-only audit, require exactly normal/readonly MIR rows; read and hash the physical decoded MIR and full-function files; recompute `complete_function_record` and graph inventory with the exact pinned capture helper; require function_name to be `sort4_stable`, and compare all resulting paths/hashes/graph facts to the report. Also compare each row's source_metadata to `_metadata_facts` of the reconstructed, pinned constructor row. Add tamper controls that alter each summary field while leaving physical files unchanged and require audit refusal.
